description: This file implements an SSE (Server-Sent Events) client for Urbit, managing WebSocket-like streaming, subscriptions, reconnections, event handling, and communication with Urbit channels.

classes.name: UrbitSSEClient
classes.description: Main class managing SSE connection, subscriptions, event processing, reconnection logic, and communication with Urbit channels.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to a specific app and path, setting up event handlers.

methods.name: sendSubscription
methods.description: Sends a subscription request to the server for a given subscription object.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes the channel and opens the SSE stream.

methods.name: openStream
methods.description: Opens the SSE stream and manages response, including error handling and reconnection.

methods.name: processStream
methods.description: Processes incoming SSE stream data, handling event parsing and reconnection logic.

methods.name: processEvent
methods.description: Parses individual SSE events, handles event IDs, acknowledgments, and event dispatching.

methods.name: poke
methods.description: Sends a poke message to the Urbit channel.

methods.name: scry
methods.description: Performs a scry request to the Urbit API.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Acknowledges receipt of an event by ID.

methods.name: attemptReconnect
methods.description: Handles reconnection logic with exponential backoff and max attempts.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the SSE connection, unsubscribes, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: putChannelPayload
methods.description: Sends payload data to the channel via PUT request.
